meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: 先宣告“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED”,再扮演主控,组建 5 名互相敌对的评审成员轮番攻击提案;只保留扛过攻击的见解,交给独立规划者用 ulw-plan 技能写成正式计划。
howto.when: 当用户要求 hyperplan、adversarial 或 cross-critique 式规划,或规划需要最高严谨度时触发;技能加载后 Claude 会先播报“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”

say.text: 给我做一个 hyperplan:把数据迁移到 PostgreSQL。
say.note: Claude 会先宣告模式开启,再启动评审。

say.text: 用对抗性交叉批判方式规划这次的版本发布方案。
say.note: 5 名敌对成员将轮流攻击方案,存活观点才进计划。

say.text: 帮我走 hyperplan 重构核心 API,要求最高严谨度。
say.note: 你会得到经攻击仍成立的正式计划。

howto.what_en: On load Claude announces “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED” and orchestrates 5 hostile reviewers who attack proposals; insights surviving the attacks are distilled and given to a dedicated planner for formalization.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for a hyperplan, adversarial or cross-critique planning, or demands maximum rigor. On load Claude immediately announces “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED” and starts the workflow.

say_en.text: Create a hyperplan for migrating our data to PostgreSQL.
say_en.note: Hostile review starts; surviving insights go to the planner.

say_en.text: Use adversarial cross-critique to plan this release launch.
say_en.note: Members attack; only survivors make the plan.

say_en.text: I need maximum rigor—run a hyperplan to refactor the core API.
say_en.note: Claude announces mode and starts the adversarial review.
